bibliographic.title: BLESS (Blood+Flesh+Soul)
bibliographic.author: Maha Deoh
bibliographic.description:
In the depths where shadows reign

and sorrow entwines with every breath,

I find myself ensnared, shackled by the weight of unyielding pain

a prisoner in the labyrinth of my own despair.

I can't find the strength to kindle my light.

Maybe,

There's no brighter tomorrow...

Bless is a game that narrates the struggle of a nobody within an unforgiving, cruel, and harsh world. He aspires to transform all of this into a semblance of normalcy from what it once was.

However, can the world be changed so easily? Perhaps he could achieve it, but at what cost? Will he persist in his intentions or halt midway? Worse yet, will he himself be molded by the world's desires? Who knows? Who cares? There is no one to help him, not even himself.

How to Play?

Throughout the narrative, you will encounter many textboxes with codes inside them.

Your task is to fill these textboxes with the correct words. For example, in one textbox, there might be the code "s5". This means you have to write a single word that starts with the letter "s" (lowercase) and has 5 letters following it. For instance, the correct answer would be "strike".

The textboxes here are case sensitive. This means that the capitalization of the letters you write into them significantly impacts the final outcome. Even a slight mistake will result in failure. So, if you answer "Strike" with a capital "S", then your answer is incorrect.

You must fill all the textboxes correctly in order to advance the story and beware! You can only save your progress in this game after successfully surviving each boss chapter, which includes a boss battle.

This game is difficult. Prepare to "Not Survive" alot!

Warning!

This game contains violence and sexual content unsuitable for players under 18 years of age.

Currently, there are only 3 chapters available. The total number of chapters this game will entail remains unknown. One thing is certain, brace yourself for enduring numerous challenges without survival being guaranteed.
